name: Amsterdam Bijlmer ArenA station
scope: Complete intrinsic Amsterdam Bijlmer ArenA station: five folded longitudinal roof ribbons with glass strips, timber soffits and steel girders/inclined supports; eight elevated track lanes, mapped platform edges including shorter metro island and real stair/light openings; separated concrete viaduct decks and piers, open diagonal concourse with intrinsic stair/escalator banks, framed platform-end glazing and low auxiliary enclosures. Exclude adjacent AFAS Live, arena, offices/shops outside the station, bus fleet, trains, people, signs/logos, public plaza and natural ground. Roof section/canopy registration, pier census and concealed details are explicit estimates; native platform/hall coordinates remain unchanged.
era: Recognizable surviving 2007 station architecture from published Qualla creator-released originals; current minor alterations and exact services are outside this exterior model.

references.caption: Heineken Music Hall and Station Amsterdam Bijlmer ArenA
Stationshal Amsterdam Bijlmer Arena met roltrappen metroperron

review.method: Native creator-released Qualla photographs and original mapped station infrastructure; complete recognizable exterior with bounded section estimates.
review.notes: Three native Qualla originals inspected and matched to primary Commons native SHA1: Mojito2007own-work PD-self platform roof and concourse photographs; Erik1980own-work PD-self overview used only for station at left, never adjacent AFAS Live. Timber soffit/steel girders/inclined supports/skylight ribbons, real raised deck and stair/escalator banks, high folded roof and lower concourse are the architectural controls. Six2005assumed-source Migdejong images, all attribution photos and unrelated subjects excluded. The panoramic image was inspected for identity/context only and does not control detailed geometry. Primary architect/builder text facts only; no images from their pages used. No external image, photographic texture or generated bitmap.
